quest.title: Battle of Revenge
quest.description: Asukara has discovered the Kairagi's whereabouts. The time has come for a rematch to reclaim his weapon...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: You're here just in time. Today's an important day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this about your weapon...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: That's right! I've been looking all over the place for clues, and I've finally determined the location of that band of Kairagi!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Today, I will redeem myself and take back my weapon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Asakura is really motivated!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: However, I mustn't make the same mistake as before. The Kairagi are numerous, and many of them are unscrupulous.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: As long as they swarm me and drain my stamina, I'll be put on the back foot, and the same thing will happen again...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Therefore, I want you to accompany me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: I was defeated by them last time because the Kairagi were able to use their numerical advantage and took turns in whittling away my stamina.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: After I ran out of energy, their leader challenged me to a duel.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: This time, I would like you to fend off the surrounding Kairagi while I challenge their leader directly.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: After I cut down that villain, I'll come and help you.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I am grateful for your assistance!

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: In short, I'll be leaving things to you.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Now then, let us not delay things. Let's head off.

choices.text: It sounds like I'll be taking on many of them at once...

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Without their numbers, those Kairagi are nothing more than a rabble.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I have faith in your skills. Even if they decide to rush at you all at once, I still believe they'll stand no chance against you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You think too highly of me...

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
dialogues.text: You? Hah, aren't you that brat from before? What, are you here to add something to my collection again?

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: No. I am here for my weapon!

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
dialogues.text: Heh, well, at least you've got some guts. But only one ally, really? You must really take me for a sucker, huh?

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
dialogues.text: But you know what? I'll give you a chance on account of your bravery, at least. Come on! Let's settle this somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
dialogues.text: Still... it wouldn't be good to leave my boys here with nothing to do, would it? I know! Why don't you ask your little helper to play with them a bit?

response.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
response.text: Hahaha. You've got some lip! Well then, boys, you heard 'em. Let 'em have it!

response.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
response.text: As for you, let's go over there.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I leave this in your hands...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll take care of it.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: You have my utmost thanks. I will slay him quickly and come to your aid.

response.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
response.text: Well, aren't you a talker yourself? You're welcome to try!

choices.text: Let's hope that their A-game is passable, at least.

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi"
dialogues.text: Agh! P—Please, spare me! Where did you get this kind of help...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Foul villain! Hand my weapon over at once!

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi"
dialogues.text: You... You're still all hung up about that...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: I am only here to retrieve my weapon. If you tell me where it is, I'll spare you.

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi"
dialogues.text: This...

choices.text: Don't waste any more words with him.

response.speaker: "Kairagi"
response.text: N—No, please! Please stop! I—I didn't say I wouldn't say anything! We don't have to get this violent!

response.speaker: "Kairagi"
response.text: Th—That weapon was taken by our boss as part of his collection. If you want it, you can just go to the camp over there to get it from him!

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Well, at least you have some sense.

response.speaker: "Kairagi"
response.text: P—Please, good sirs, I've told you...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Out of my sight!

response.speaker: "Kairagi"
response.text: At once!

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Not much martial skill to speak of, but he was quite the runner.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not to mention pretty quick to sell his buddies out, too.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: The Kairagi are ultimately a motley band who've banded together for their own selfish gain. Loyalty plays no part here, nor does conviction.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: The moment trouble starts brewing on the horizon, they will pack up and leave. This is all too common.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: But fortunately, I had you here to help me. I doubt that they would have capitulated so easily otherwise.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: However, our next stop is their main encampment.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: We will follow our original stratagem. I will take their leader on, and leave the small fry to you.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Much obliged!

choices.text: I can take ten of them at once, no problem!
Come on, let's find someone else...

talks.objective: Defeat the subordinates of the Kairagi Leader

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: From your steady breathing, it seems that those Kairagi were no match for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And it seems that you were victorious as well.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: That is indeed the case. Though I must admit that to my shame, I allowed him to escape with but a single stab from my spear due to a feint on his part.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Still, his wound was very severe. I do not believe that he will emerge to do much ill for at least a few years.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: More importantly, I have defeated him myself and reclaimed my weapon. I am henceforth free from the stain of that humiliation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Congratulations, Asakura.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Indeed, I owe you thanks, but I cannot rest yet.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: The reason for this whole incident was my lack of training. I will continue to train hard and refine my skills.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: As such... I shall be counting on you in the future as well to spar with me!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Please take these as a token of my thanks. It isn't much, but do accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Thank you once again!

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi"
dialogues.text: It's you again? You barely escaped that last time and you're coming back for more?

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi"
dialogues.text: You've brought a sidekick as well... Hmph, seeing as you haven't learned anything, then we won't bother holding back!

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi"
dialogues.text: Let's go, everyone! Take them down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: While Asakura is dueling their leader, let's quickly beat these guys!

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
dialogues.text: It's often said that a Doushin's weapon is their dignity. You've lost to me already, so I'm surprised you had the audacity to challenge me to another duel!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: I came here because of my previous defeat... I'll wash away the shame with my own two hands!

dialogues.speaker: "Kairagi" Leader
dialogues.text: Such insolence... This time, no one will be here to help you!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: I don't need help. I can cut you down, myself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Asakura's over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems like the Kairagi's leader is running away. That must mean Asakura won the duel!
